The application is disposed of accordingly.

The present writ petition under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks following prayers:
"a) Pass an order quashing the F.I.R. No. 302/2020 dated 06.10.2020 registered at P.S. Shahdara under section 498A/406/34 Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act alongwith chargesheet pending before Ms. Shruti Sharma,
Ld. Metropolitan,.Magistrate, Karkadooma District Court and next listed on 25.02.2023.
b) In the Alternative, pass an order issuing an appropriate writ, order or direction holding that the pendency of the F .LR no. 302/2020 dated 06.10.2020 registered at P.S. Shahdara under section 498A/406/34 Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act does not bar the participation of the Petitioner in the tender process issued by Respondent No. 6.
c) Pass any other further order(s) as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
Issue notice.
